moments.title: UK Braces For Fifth Heatwave
moments.blurb: A fifth heatwave of the year is forecast for the UK, with temperatures potentially hitting 35-36°C by next Thursday, particularly across southern and eastern England, prompting Yellow Heat Health Alerts.

angles.name: Heatwave Alert
angles.copy: Yellow Heat Health Alerts are out as the UK braces for its FIFTH heatwave of the year. Temperatures could hit 36°C by next Thursday, especially in the South East. Stay safe, stay hydrated!

angles.name: Cool Down Tunes
angles.copy: It's heating up! With the UK on Yellow Heat Health Alert and temps soaring to 36°C next week, what's your go-to soundtrack for keeping cool?

angles.name: Local Impact
angles.copy: Devon and the South West are set for soaring temperatures as the UK enters its fifth heatwave. Expect highs around 30°C. Keep an eye on friends and neighbours.

moments.title: The Hundred Cricket Continues
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket competition is in full swing across the UK, with men's and women's matches today and throughout the week, leading up to the finals on Sunday, August 16th.

angles.name: Weekend Matches
angles.copy: The Hundred is back this weekend with more explosive cricket! Catch the action today and tomorrow as teams battle for a spot in next week's finals.

angles.name: Welsh Fire Update
angles.copy: Huge week for Welsh Fire in The Hundred! They're in action again with key matches this weekend and early next week at Sophia Gardens. Can they make the final?

angles.name: Road to the Final
angles.copy: The Hundred finals are just over a week away! Who are you backing to lift the trophy on August 16th? Every match counts now!

moments.title: Boardmasters Festival Wraps Up
moments.blurb: Boardmasters Festival, the UK's premier surf and music event, is in its final days in Newquay, Cornwall, with the last acts and surf competitions wrapping up on Sunday, August 9th.

angles.name: Final Day Vibes
angles.copy: Last chance to catch the incredible vibes at Boardmasters! Who's heading down to Newquay for the final day of music, surf, and sun?

angles.name: Cornwall Calling
angles.copy: The Cornish coast is alive with the sound of Boardmasters! Don't miss the final day of epic performances and world-class surfing at Watergate Bay.

angles.name: Devon & Cornwall Party
angles.copy: Boardmasters is bringing the party to a close in Newquay this weekend! Shout out if you're there or wish you were!

moments.title: London Dance Festivals This Weekend
moments.blurb: Maiden Voyage Festival takes over Burgess Park in London today, August 8th, followed by Eastern Electrics at the same venue tomorrow, August 9th, featuring top electronic artists.

angles.name: Burgess Park Buzz
angles.copy: Burgess Park is THE place to be this weekend for electronic music fans! Maiden Voyage today, then Eastern Electrics tomorrow. Who's got their tickets?

angles.name: Dance All Weekend
angles.copy: Your weekend soundtrack sorted! Maiden Voyage and Eastern Electrics are bringing the beats to London's Burgess Park. Get ready to move!

moments.title: Community Shield Countdown
moments.blurb: The 2026 Community Shield, the traditional curtain-raiser for the English football season, takes place on Sunday, August 16th, at Principality Stadium in Cardiff, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal against FA Cup holders Manchester City.

angles.name: Season Kick-Off
angles.copy: Only 8 days until the official start of the English football season! Arsenal vs Man City in the Community Shield. Who's taking home the first silverware?

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Big Game
angles.copy: Principality Stadium in Cardiff is set to host the Community Shield next Sunday! Huge game between Arsenal and Man City right here in Wales. Get ready!

moments.title: Happy 65th to The Edge
moments.blurb: U2 guitarist The Edge (David Evans) celebrates his 65th birthday today, August 8th.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to U2's iconic guitarist, The Edge! What's your favourite U2 riff or song?

angles.name: U2 Memories
angles.copy: From 'With Or Without You' to 'Vertigo', The Edge's unique sound has defined U2 for decades. Celebrating his 65th today!

angles.name: Mendes Playlist
angles.copy: Celebrating Shawn Mendes turning 28 today! Time to put 'Senorita' on repeat.

angles.name: 80s Rap Royalty

moments.title: Creamfields Festival on the Horizon
moments.blurb: Creamfields, one of the UK's largest electronic music festivals, is set to take place from August 27th-30th in Daresbury, Cheshire, featuring a massive line-up of leading DJs and electronic acts.

angles.name: Dance Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Creamfields is almost here! Get ready for four days of non-stop electronic music in Daresbury. Who's got their tickets and their dancing shoes ready?

angles.name: Cheshire's Biggest Party
angles.copy: Cheshire, get ready to rave! Creamfields is just weeks away, bringing the biggest names in dance music to Daresbury.
